sources.entry: FlatPress - A lightweight, easy-to-set-up flat-file blogging engine. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: FlatPress is a lightweight, flat-file blogging engine written in PHP that stores all data in files and needs no database.
summary.what_it_does: FlatPress is a self-contained blog engine that runs on plain PHP without a database, keeping posts and data as files. The README describes a plugin system with widget support and theme-based customization powered by Smarty. It includes a comments feature with spam protection and a multi-language setup where more languages can be added. Installation is described as downloading, unzipping and uploading the files, then running a web-based installer. The README says it runs on any web server with PHP 7.2 to PHP 8.5, and it lists PHPStan and CodeQL checks run through GitHub Actions.
how_to_run: Upload the files to your web server
Browse to the server and run the FlatPress installer
notable: No database required; all data is stored in files
Automated PHPStan and CodeQL checks via GitHub Actions
caveats: Requires a web server with PHP 7.2 to PHP 8.5
README does not describe a demo URL or hosting options beyond general web servers
